context:
Goal: no lane reads an instruction it cannot follow.
Problem (rule): when a lane's act is refused, the refusal text still prints "type override". A lane cannot type it, so the line is dead there. The lane wants to reword that shared line in hooks/override.py (the offer text), which edits a hook every session uses, so it waits for your word.
Based on (read): lane lane-cards, via the coordinator 16:57 CST Nov 13; triage has not read hooks/override.py. Ruling R13 point 3 says an act that needs your typed word becomes a page item.
Departs from: main — the refusal text says "type override" in every session; this words it for a lane as "routes to its parent".
Meanwhile: the lane keeps the old line.
